plan.selection_rule: Use final pre-registered interaction budget for every run; no test-based selection.
plan.exploratory_caveat: Sparse and no-fault comparisons use one seed and are descriptive only.

evaluation_release.hash_normalization: CRLF-to-LF for .json/.jsonl/.py/.md UTF-8 text; raw bytes for binary files
evaluation_release.latency_caveat: Episode latency/throughput were measured with the recorded concurrent worker count; no speedup is inferred against historical serial evaluations.

train.caveat: Only three independent seeds; bootstrap interval is descriptive and coarse.

dev.caveat: Only three independent seeds; bootstrap interval is descriptive and coarse.

test.caveat: Only three independent seeds; bootstrap interval is descriptive and coarse.

transfer.caveat: Only three independent seeds; bootstrap interval is descriptive and coarse.
